payout_quote: All eligible participants with OCD, upon completion of the study, will receive up to a total of $450 as compensation toward time participating and as reimbursement toward any parking fees. This includes $150 for completing the infusion visit and $300 upon completion of two MRI scans ($150 for each MRI scan visit).
steps: Complete virtual preliminary screening visit (~3 hours): screening survey, MD evaluation, psychiatric history, diagnostic interview
Complete hybrid study screening visit (~4 hours): consent discussion (virtual), physical exam and lab tests (in-person, Psychiatry building, Stanford)
Attend in-person ketamine infusion visit (~7 hours) at Stanford Center for Cognitive and Neurobiological Imaging
Attend in-person post-infusion brain scan visit (~4 hours)
Complete five virtual follow-up visits (~2 hours each)
catches: Only eligible participants are paid; medical/psychiatric screening required and not everyone qualifies
Ketamine (a psychoactive dissociative drug) is administered; medical risks apply and are covered in informed consent
Payment is per-milestone ($150 infusion visit + $150 per MRI scan visit), paid only on completion
Ages 18-65 with OCD required; healthy adults are paid a lower amount (up to $150)
Travel to Stanford (Bay Area, CA) required for in-person visits
MRI scans, blood draws, and medication abstinence restrictions apply
Total active time is ~28 hours across screening, visits, and follow-ups
Amount is 'up to $450' - no stated floor for partial completion
biggest_catch: You must pass medical and psychiatric screening and receive ketamine (a psychoactive drug) - eligibility is strict and medical risks apply (full disclosure at informed consent).
eligibility: Ages 18-65 with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD); must pass screening survey, MD evaluation/psychiatric history, physical exam, and laboratory tests
timing: Currently listed on Stanford Psychiatry research opportunities page (posted and live); screening and visits scheduled after enrollment
